'''Eeusu Estornii''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zeuol]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="DB" /> from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ord Zeuol system/Legends|Ord Zeuol system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Ord planet">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> [[Ord Zeuol]]<ref name="SWC:TP" /> who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Estornii was one of the thousands of mourners who attended<ref name="DB" /> the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="DB" /> with whom Estornii had worked closely.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> The funeral took place in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]],<ref name="CSWE Theed">{{CSWECite|III|235|Theed}}</ref> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="ROTS date" /> At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], Estornii was part of a procession of senators which followed behind Amidala's coffin,<ref name="ROTS" /> where Estornii wore a [[Color/Legends|dark red]] patterned [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and pieces of black jewelry on her forehead. Estornii had blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]] which were tied into pigtails in front of her head, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and pale skin.<ref name="DaG" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal===
{{Quote|Rick [McCallum] seemed a bit freaked out by it. I feel wonderful, though. The costume is rather heavy, and it’s been a long day, but going back to the desk seems a bit anticlimactic.|Jacqui Louez, on the Eeusu Estornii costume|<ref name="Crew Cameos">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030916.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Crew Cameos}}</ref>}}
[[File:JacquiLisaAndGeorge-SWI73.png|200px|right|thumb|Jacqui Louez (right) poses in costume with George Lucas and [[Lisa Shaunessy]] (left) on the set of ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
Eeusu Estornii was first alluded to by the "Crew Cameos" edition in [[Episode III Set Diary]], written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]]. At that point, Estornii was only described as a senator portrayed by [[Jacqui Louez]],<ref name="Crew Cameos" /> assistant to producer [[Rick McCallum]] and director [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWI 73">{{InsiderCite|73|Prequel Update}}</ref> Louez had to undergo two hours of makeup work for the character's brief appearance, but championed the senator's unique beauty.<ref name="Crew Cameos" />

The character's appearance was later revealed by the [[Star Wars Insider 73|seventy-third]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', in the "[[Prequel Update]]" article written by [[Jane Irene Kelly]]<ref name="SWI 73" /> released on [[January 13]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWI 73 release date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20031219.html|text=Princess Leia Speaks in ''Star Wars'' #48}}</ref> Upon the release of ''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' by [[Jonathan W. Rinzler]]<ref name="Making Of">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="Making Of release date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20040719.html|text=Del Rey Goes Behind the Scenes of Episode III}}</ref> the character was identified as "Senator Jacquito," a [[tuckerization]] of Jacqui Louez's name,<ref name="Making Of" /> though the character was actually unnamed by production.<ref name="TFN Rostoni" /> The character went on to appear in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the last film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]],<ref name="ROTS" /> which released on [[May 19]], 2005,<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> in funeral procession scenes shot on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on September 16, 2003.<ref name="Making Of" />

===Naming===
{{Quote|One other thing that I'd like to explain is the character Eeusu Estornii -- The character wasn't actually named after me in the usual sense. There were a handful of characters in ''Revenge of the Sith'' that didn't have names. The characters were sent around to a group of us and I was given the opportunity to pick a character and name it, which I did. So I rather named the character after myself -- it was nice to be included in the group that got to do this, but it's not like somebody named this character after me (well, I guess I'm somebody...).|[[Sue Rostoni]]|<ref name="TFN Rostoni">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31762425|board=Literature|thread=Sue Rostoni Retiring on July 2011|user=SueRostoni|date=2011-06-14|time=3:14 PM}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dressing_a_Galaxy_Senate trio.png|200px|left|thumb|The Estornii costume, displayed alongside costumes for [[Mas Amedda]] and [[Finis Valorum]] at the Fashion Institute of Design and Merchandising Museum in Los Angeles, CA.]]
The name "Senator Jacquito" was supplanted by "Eeusu Estornii" by the release of ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], [[2005]].<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref> This name originated with [[Sue Rostoni]],<ref name="TFN Rostoni" /> executive editor of [[Lucas Licensing]],<ref name="Retire">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/rostoni_retirement/index.html|text=Sue Rostoni to Retire as ''Star Wars'' Editor}}</ref> who was part of a group of individuals given unnamed characters from ''Revenge of the Sith'', so Rostoni named the character after herself.<ref name="TFN Rostoni" /> Rostoni went on to use the character's name as her own screen name on [[StarWars.com]], where she also hypothesized that Estornii was in tears due to Senator Amidala's death.<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1230#13464906|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIP|author=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2005-12-01|time=1:46 PM|quote=The only official reference that I know of is in CHRONICLES:  THE PREQUELS by Steve Sansweet and Pablo Hidalgo. There it says that Senator Eeusu Estornii is from Ord Zeuol. She worked closely with Padme and attended her funeral. In tears. Well, it doesn't say "in tears" but I do believe she was quite broken up.}} {{C|In response to: What is the species, homeworld, and home sector of Sue's Senator character, and can it be put into a future reference?}}</ref>

Eeusu Estornii's name was misspelled in the "[[Long Ago, Far Away: Galaxy Fashion]]" article in the [[Star Wars Insider 85|eighty-fifth]] edition of ''Star Wars Insider'',<ref name="SWI 85">{{InsiderCite|85|Long Ago, Far Away: Galaxy Fashion}}</ref> released on [[November 28]], 2005,<ref name="SWI 85 release date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20051101.html|text=More Vader in ''Star Wars Insider'' #85}}</ref> where Eeusu is spelled as "Ecusu,"<ref name="SWI 85" /> and in Estornii's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on StarWars.com, which misspells her first name as Eusu.<ref name="DB" />
